summary_zh: 9 道题的答案逐一重算、核对过，推导和数字都对。只改了两处小地方：参考解答开头把 KL(π_θ‖π_ref) 叫成“正向 KL”，而文献里通常管这个方向叫“反向 KL”，已改正；Q5 表格里说 GRPO 的方差“随 1/√G 下降”，实际上方差随 1/G 下降，随 1/√G 下降的是标准误差，已改正。

issues.where: 参考解答 开头说明（Q1 之前）
issues.problem_zh: 原文写“下文所有 KL 项都是正向的 KL(π_θ‖π_ref)”。方向本身（期望取在 π_θ 上、逐 token 惩罚估计的就是它）没错，但名字叫反了：文献里（例如推广 DPO 的 f-DPO 论文《Beyond Reverse KL》）把 KL(π_θ‖π_ref) 叫反向 KL，把 KL(π_ref‖π_θ) 叫正向 KL。面试时照着说“正向 KL”会被纠正。
issues.change_zh: 去掉“正向的”，改为“KL(π_θ‖π_ref)，期望取在正在训练的策略 π_θ 上（文献里通常把这个方向叫作反向 KL）……而不是 KL(π_ref‖π_θ)”。

issues.problem_zh: PPO/GRPO 对比表的“方差”一行写 GRPO 的方差“随 1/√G 下降”。实际上 G 个样本的组均值方差是 σ²/G：G 变成 4 倍，方差变成 1/4，标准误差才是减半。模拟梯度估计量的方差随 G 的变化，对数斜率也约为 -1，而不是 -0.5。
issues.change_zh: 改为“随 1/G 下降（噪声本身，即标准误差，随 1/√G）”。

issues.problem_zh: 原有检查没有覆盖 Q5 里方差随 G 怎么变这条说法。
issues.change_zh: 新增一小段：对 0/1 奖励精确枚举出 G=4、16、64 时组均值的方差，断言 G 每变成 4 倍方差就变成 1/4（按原来 1/√G 的说法应是 1/2，该断言不成立）。

numbering: 9 **QN.** questions and 9 **QN.** answers in each language, same ### headings in statement and reference, code blocks byte-identical across languages
read every Chinese answer against the English one: same formulas and numbers

Q1: torch autograd on an exactly enumerated 3-token autoregressive policy with parameters shared across positions: score-function gradient equals autograd gradient of J, E[score]=0, baselines 0/E[r]/-5/10 leave the mean unchanged, b=E[r] cuts total variance 14.8 -> 3.2
Q2: closed-form table (value and d/d rho) compared with torch autograd on 20000 random (rho, A, eps); the four numeric values 2.4, 1.0, -3.0, -1.6 recomputed

Q3: exact gradient of E[r] - beta*KL(pi_theta||pi_ref) by autograd vs the GAE-weighted score estimator enumerated with the page's indexing: lambda=1 matches for an arbitrary V, lambda=0 and 0.5 match only with the true V, flipping the sign of the KL term breaks it; E_pi_theta[sum_t log pi_theta/pi_ref] equals KL(pi_theta||pi_ref), not KL(pi_ref||pi_theta); telescoped lambda=1 form asserted per sample
Q4: advantages recomputed with statistics.stdev and torch.std for (1,0,1,0) and (1,1,1,1); std and gap numbers for 50%/10%/90%/2% of 100 (0.5025/0.3015/0.1407; 1.99/3.32/7.11; ratio 3.57)

Q5: simulated variance of the group-baseline policy-gradient estimate for G=4..128 (log-log slope -0.94 unnormalised, -1.11 std-normalised; variance of the group mean -1.00) and exact binomial variance of the group mean

Q6: E[u]=1 in exact rationals and E[k1]=E[k3]=KL on 300 random pairs, k3>=0 per sample, exact Var(k1)/Var(k3) near and far from the reference (ratio 7000x at tiny KL, k3 worse only at KL~0.76), fraction of 64-sample batches with negative k1 mean, the u=1.01 numbers

Q7: BFGS maximiser of E[r]-beta*KL over the simplex vs the closed form (diff 8e-8), optimum value = beta*log Z, r = beta*log(pi*/pi_ref)+beta*log Z; minimising the population DPO loss with Bradley-Terry labels from the true reward recovers pi* (diff 3e-9)

Q9: Var_mu(W) = (1+chi2)^T - 1 in exact rationals for 20 random (pi, mu), T=1..5; IS unbiased when mu=0 only where pi*r=0 and biased otherwise; capped weight mean <1 and variance <= c^2 by enumeration at T=10; KL/chi2 -> 1/2 near pi=mu in both KL directions

Q8 and the non-numeric parts of Q3/Q4/Q5/Q9 (critic cost, the two GRPO biases, reward-hacking symptoms and mitigations, sources of unintended off-policy data) checked by reading against the DPO, GRPO and Dr. GRPO papers as I know them; not runnable
